profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, traded under the ticker TDC. Its website describes it as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. The company presents its Autonomous Knowledge Platform as a way to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and points to a portfolio of products and services spanning AI, analytics, and cloud solutions. It also says it partners with other providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge to customers.

The site's framing places Teradata in the enterprise data and analytics market, with AI positioned as the central theme rather than a side offering. The company describes the platform as environment-agnostic, able to connect and scale across whatever infrastructure a customer already runs, and emphasizes governance and trust alongside scale.

On the litigation side, the company's recorded exposure is concentrated in California, where 281 cases are counted.
